body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> HDi(www.hdi.co.il) presented its high-definition player system 'Dune HD Center' at the CES 2009. The Dune HD Center is the most universal and powerful full HD(1080p) solution with Blu-ray support.
